page.title: Webhooks
page.subtitle: orgtable tells other systems what happens in your boards, signed so they know it was us.

failing.one: {count} webhook is failing or was switched off.
failing.other: {count} webhooks are failing or were switched off.

page.noKey: Webhooks need ORGTABLE_SECRET_KEY on the server to keep their signing secrets. Ask whoever runs this instance.
page.verifyText: Each request carries these headers. Compute HMAC-SHA256 of the timestamp t, a dot and the raw body with your secret, and compare it with v1; refuse timestamps older than 5 minutes.
page.scopeNote: Organization-wide webhooks carry the boards shared with the whole organization. A private board's events only go to webhooks of that board.

form.name: Name
form.urlHint: HTTPS only. Addresses inside private networks are refused.
form.scopeOrg: Every board shared with the organization
form.secretOnce: Copy it now: it will not be shown again.
form.secretHidden: The secret is kept encrypted and never shown again. Rotate it to get a new one; the old one keeps working for 24 hours.
form.deleteText: Its log of deliveries goes too.

integrations.title: Apps and incoming
integrations.subtitle: Post what happens to your team's chat, and let other tools create cards.
integrations.slackText: Create an incoming webhook in Slack and paste its URL.
integrations.discordText: Channel settings › Integrations › Webhooks, then paste its URL.
integrations.teamsText: Add the Incoming Webhook connector (or a Workflows webhook) and paste its URL.
integrations.incomingText: A secret URL that creates a card in a list each time something POSTs to it: a web form, an alert, Zapier…
integrations.urlOnce: Copy this URL now: it will not be shown again. Anyone with it can create cards.
integrations.howToText: Only title is required. It also takes description, labels (names of the board's labels), due (a date) and assignee (an email of someone on the board). Up to 60 cards a minute per URL.

keys.title: API keys
keys.subtitle: Keys of {name}, not of a person: for integrations that must keep working when someone leaves… as long as whoever created them stays.
keys.name: Name
keys.once: Copy it now: it will not be shown again.
keys.note: A key only sees the boards of {name}, at most as an editor: it never deletes boards or manages people, roles or backups. Only its fingerprint (SHA-256) is kept, so not even admins can recover it. Its use is written to the activity log, and it stops working if whoever created it leaves.
